pokedexEntries.sc: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face.

pokedexEntries.vi: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

pokedexEntries.za: Packs of these Pokémon are incredibly close-knit. In order to be taken seriously, Maschiff intimidate others by wearing a grumpy expression.
